teardown_gate._note: the first non-emergency teardown gate of the three D1 search attempts. 11 of 11 checks true, including required_products_secured.

committed_top_4._what_this_is: THE AUTHORITATIVE SELECTION, in the order stage1_selection.json records it. Its size is the design's behavioural_design.top_k, widened 2 -> 4 by a maintainer decision of 2026-10-07 before this search ran.

the_finding_that_matters_for_the_top_k_d.headline: TOP-4 IS NOT THE FOUR BEST LEAVES BY THE PROXY. The ranking policy rotates selection over distinct LINEAGES across Pareto fronts, so widening 2 -> 4 bought STRUCTURAL DIVERSITY, not score breadth.

what_was_skipped_and_its_score.why_not: shares the lineage of the front-0 state already selected

the_fourth_finalist.why_it_is_in: it is the only width-first lineage that produced a complete leaf, and the policy keeps one state per lineage before taking a second from any lineage.
the_fourth_finalist.worse_than: seven leaves that were NOT selected

the_finding_that_matters_for_the_top_k_d.why_this_is_material: the Top-4 widening was adopted to stop the cheap state-eval ranking from eliminating a candidate it cannot reliably rank -- specifically a candidate the proxy places 3rd or 4th that might win after recovery. Those candidates are dominance ranks 2 and 4, at 7.650625 and 8.310306, and they are STILL excluded. What the widening actually added is a mid-pack leaf and the worst-but-one leaf, both chosen for lineage diversity. Whether that serves the stated purpose is a scientific question this closeout does not decide.
the_finding_that_matters_for_the_top_k_d.what_a_top_2_would_have_selected: dominance ranks 1 and 3 -- the same first two members above, because lineage rotation applies at every width.
the_finding_that_matters_for_the_top_k_d._not_claimed: that lineage diversity is the wrong objective, or that score-ordered retention would be better. Neither has been measured. The point is only that the retention width and the retention CRITERION are different choices, and widening the first did not change the second.

products_secured.authorized_path: the launcher's own fetch_products, 1.11 GiB each, every one re-identified against the selection record: rc=0, identity MATCHED
products_secured.independent_cross_check: an out-of-band 8-stream byte-range transfer verified the same four against the same single_shard_sha256 values, at 8.5-11.4 MB/s, before the launcher's fetch completed. Both paths agree.
products_secured._durability_note: these bytes are a dev-box-local copy. A later authorized operation that consumes the weights -- the Top-4 x 2-seed recovery screening -- will need them on a pod, and P8.4 says they travel only when a consumer actually reads them.

non_root_depth_confirmed._why_it_corroborates: two independent hosts, 23 observations between them, agree to within 3%. The DEPTH operator is GPU-bound, so a host difference does not move it -- which is what makes this a property of the operator off the root rather than of a machine.

host_variance_elsewhere._why: these are CPU and disk bound and this host was markedly faster, which is why stage C finished in 528 min against a projection of 778-876 made from the slower host's figures.

where_this_applies: any future search executing depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1 off the root

bound_vs_actual.verdict: the retained bound was correct and was not approached.

what_this_authorizes.next_rung: Top-4 x 2-seed recovery screening is a separately authorized session and is NOT started. The maintainer reserved the Top-2-versus-Top-4 retention decision for before screening begins, and the finding above is the evidence that decision now has.
